test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In December 2024, which day honoured Dr BR Ambedkar’s contribution to social justice?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahaparinirvan Diwas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahaparinirvan Diwas** is observed on **6th December** every year to honor the contributions of **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, the architect of the Indian Constitution, towards social justice, equality, and empowerment.
 
• The term **Mahaparinirvan** signifies the attainment of ultimate liberation or salvation, which is a Buddhist concept.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar, a staunch advocate of **Dalit rights**, passed away on **6th December 1956**, and the day has been observed as Mahaparinirvan Diwas since then.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar was instrumental in combating **social discrimination**, particularly towards the marginalized sections of society.
 
• On this day, people across India pay homage to Dr. Ambedkar by visiting his memorial at **Chaitya Bhoomi** in Mumbai.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar's work in the fields of **law, economics, and social reform** continues to inspire millions of people worldwide.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India’s highest civilian honor, posthumously in **1990**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Constitution Awareness Day**__

 __
 
• **Constitution Awareness Day** is celebrated on **26th November**, the day the Indian Constitution was adopted in **1949**.
 
• The day is also referred to as **Constitution Day** or **Samvidhan Divas**.
 
• It is observed to spread awareness about the importance of the Indian Constitution and its role in ensuring **democracy and justice**.
 
 
 
• **National Equality Day**__
 __
 
• While the term **National Equality Day** is significant, it is not officially recognized or associated with Dr. Ambedkar's contributions.
 
• The concept focuses on promoting **equal rights** and opportunities for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **Ambedkar Smriti Diwas**__
 
 
• While it may sound relevant, **Ambedkar Smriti Diwas** is not an officially recognized term for the day honoring Dr. Ambedkar.
 
• The official day for commemorating Dr. Ambedkar’s contributions is **Mahaparinirvan Diwas**.
